Automation technicians in South Florida and Alabama write and load controller logic without a second reviewer; integrator and packager technicians connect their own laptops, which carry controller programming software, to field networks during site visits without a check; field crews scrap retired RTUs and HMIs without wiping them; the 4 Production Controllers describe the NRC notice procedure, say it has no trigger for cyber-caused abnormal operations, and report no training on such events; Production Controllers have no defined route for reporting unexplained HMI behavior; truck tickets are not reconciled to SCADA tank levels in Alabama

title: General Counsel confirmation of TSA status and regulatory watch log
source_system: Email from the General Counsel; regulatory watch log
what_it_shows: General Counsel confirms that the company has received no TSA notification for its gathering system; the quarterly regulatory watch by the General Counsel and the Security Manager starts in 2026 Q3

title: External TLS scan
source_system: Scanning tool run by the Security Analyst
what_it_shows: Cloud, SaaS, jump host and shipper portal endpoints use TLS; the OT DMZ and headquarters tunnels to the cloud use IPsec

title: Gap analysis samples: operator qualification records and IT/OT meeting minutes
source_system: Pipeline records tool; Security Manager's files
what_it_shows: OQ qualification records (15 sampled): all current. IT/OT security meeting minutes: present for 6 of 6 months from 2026-01 to 2026-06

title: Audit committee minutes, 2026-09-16
source_system: Board audit committee materials
what_it_shows: The committee received the 2026 risk assessment and its treatment plans, and noted the risk appetite statements approved by the CEO; next report at the December 2026 meeting

title: Control assessment: account management
source_system: IdP and OT directory exports; SCADA local account lists; samples of 25 of 96 terminations, 15 of 38 transfers and 25 of 110 new accounts; SCADA and Automation Manager and VP IT interviews
what_it_shows: Corporate, SaaS, cloud, jump host and OCC HMI accounts handled as required in all sampled items; 4 of 25 sampled leavers still active in SCADA local accounts at the South Florida office or the BCC 9 to 64 days after leaving, with IdP accounts disabled on time for 25 of 25; the shared engineering account is used by 9 people under one authorization and its password was not changed after 2 automation technicians left in 2026; SCADA local accounts reviewed annually (last 2025-11); the 25 sampled hires had background checks on file

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: Data platform permission export; SCADA role export; Production Accounting Director and Reservoir Engineering Manager interviews
what_it_shows: All 34 engineers can read the full royalty owner deck copy with Social Security numbers, while analytics need only owner counts and decimal interests; the shared field engineering account holds administrator rights on South Florida and BCC HMIs

title: Control assessment: privileged accounts
source_system: Privileged access management vault report; SCADA server and engineering workstation administrator lists; OT Security Engineer interview
what_it_shows: The vault covers cloud and directory administrators only; 6 standing local administrator accounts on SCADA servers and the 4 OCC engineering workstations are outside it

title: Control assessment: remote access
source_system: POL-02; jump host configuration; 25 of 212 jump host sessions (July 2026); external scan of company and cellular address ranges (2026-08-12); 2 of 4 compressor station walkthroughs
what_it_shows: 25 of 25 sampled jump host sessions approved by the OCC shift lead and recorded; no configuration or connection requirements for the packager's 4 cellular gateways or the flow computer vendor's modem, which are always on and were never authorized; 2 of 4 gateways accepted inbound internet connections (stop-and-notify)

title: Control assessment: literacy training
source_system: Training records (25 of 110 new hires; 30 of 485 field crew and driver records); phishing reports; interviews with 20 staff
what_it_shows: 25 of 25 new hires completed security and privacy training; quarterly phishing simulations (June 2026 click rate 6.1%); content updated yearly and after events; 9 of 30 sampled field crew members and drivers had no record of the 2026 field briefing or annual privacy content; Production Controllers received no training when the leak analytics tool went live

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: SIEM log source list; draft STD-08; SCADA event journal settings at the OCC, the South Florida office and the BCC
what_it_shows: Event types identified for IT sources, coordinated with the MDR provider and reviewed in 2026-03; no event types specified or logged centrally for South Florida and BCC SCADA servers and HMIs, engineering workstations or flow computers, and no rationale for OT event types

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MDR monthly reports; OT sensor alert log; OT Security Engineer interview
what_it_shows: Findings reported monthly to the Security Manager and the COO; OT records reviewed only in business hours; South Florida and BCC SCADA logs not reviewed

title: Control assessment: audit record retention
source_system: SIEM retention setting; historian event journal configuration
what_it_shows: The SIEM keeps 1 year; the historian event journal and field office HMI logs roll over after 30 days

title: Control assessment: baseline configuration
source_system: Baseline documents; controller program repository report; South Florida and BCC HMI configuration exports
what_it_shows: OCC baselines reviewed at the 2025 upgrade and in 2026-03; no baselines for the South Florida and BCC HMIs; the repository holds about 60% of controller programs; the 2026 compression station additions, including the packager gateways, were installed without updating a baseline

title: Control assessment: configuration change control
source_system: CAB tickets (15 of 44 Panhandle changes); 20 of 58 South Florida and Alabama controller work orders; pump station setpoint change records; CAB minutes
what_it_shows: 15 of 15 sampled CAB changes approved, implemented as approved, reviewed and retained, with weekly CAB meetings; 13 of 20 sampled South Florida and Alabama controller changes had no change record, review or impact analysis; writes to pump station pressure setpoints are not alarmed, and MOP-related setpoints are changed by work order with no second reviewer

title: Control assessment: access restrictions for change
source_system: Software inventory; controller password log; integrator laptop check during the field visit; cabinet inspections at 6 pads
what_it_shows: Physical and logical change restrictions defined and approved; controller passwords shared by area; 2 integrator laptops observed in the field carried controller programming software and area passwords

title: Control assessment: component inventory
source_system: OT sensor asset list; South Florida and Alabama area spreadsheets; physical count at 6 sampled well pads
what_it_shows: 12 of 41 devices found at the 6 sampled pads were missing from the area spreadsheets; about 70% of OT assets inventoried; the area spreadsheets lack model, firmware, communications path, owner and criticality, and are updated ad hoc

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: 2024 contingency plan; draft OT recovery and BCC failover procedures; BIA; emergency response plan; pipeline emergency procedures; binders at the OCC, BCC and South Florida office; COO and Control Room Manager interviews
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan identifies essential functions, priorities, roles, contacts and manual operations and is reviewed yearly and protected; no recovery metrics; no written steps for a SCADA rebuild or for BCC failover and failback; the OT recovery and failover procedures were unapproved drafts; the South Florida and BCC binders held the 2024 plan without the drafts; the plan was not updated for the 2025 OT DMZ, the 2026 compression station additions or the 2023 test results

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Restore test records (2025 historian restore; quarterly cloud restores since 2026 Q1); 2023 BCC test report
what_it_shows: Results of the 2025 historian restore and the quarterly cloud restores reviewed; no full BCC failover test since the 2023 partial test; no SCADA server restored from the offline image; corrective actions from the 2023 test not tracked

title: Control assessment: alternate processing site
source_system: BCC configuration; SCADA configuration synchronization log; BCC walkthrough (2026-08-12)
what_it_shows: The BCC has 4 HMIs, radio and cellular front ends and a generator; the standby server's SCADA configuration was last synchronized in 2026-03; the BCC has no OT DMZ, an unsupported operating system and a shared engineering account

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports (31 of 31 days, July 2026); vault lock setting; offline image log; BCC storage inspection
what_it_shows: 31 of 31 July backup days completed for cloud workloads and system documentation, with write-once retention, encryption and separate keys; about 40% of controller programs are not in the repository or any backup; weekly offline SCADA images are staged on a network share at the BCC before being copied to drives in the BCC safe

title: Control assessment: recovery and reconstitution
source_system: P05 recovery priorities; P08 draft runbooks; SCADA and Automation Manager interview
what_it_shows: SCADA recovery within the 12-hour RTO has not been demonstrated; rebuild from a clean image, controller verification and failback are not documented or tested

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: IdP export; SCADA account lists; observation of HMI sign-in at the OCC, the South Florida office and the BCC; packager gateway login page
what_it_shows: OCC users are unique; South Florida and BCC HMIs use one shared engineering account, so commands are logged under that account; the packager gateways use one vendor-wide shared password

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: Conditional access policy; sign-in test on 25 of 38 privileged accounts (IdP, cloud, directory, jump host)
what_it_shows: MFA with hardware keys enforced for 25 of 25 sampled privileged accounts; network administration of SCADA servers only through the jump host with MFA

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: Password policy; controller password spreadsheet; default-credential test on 20 field devices and the 4 packager gateways; OT Security Engineer interview
what_it_shows: IdP password rules and service account vaulting in place; 2 of 20 sampled South Florida cellular modems still had the manufacturer's default administrator password; the 4 packager gateways use the packager's shared password, the same at other customers' sites; controller passwords changed yearly and kept in a spreadsheet readable by all area staff; the shared engineering account password not changed when 2 members left in 2026

title: Control assessment: incident response testing
source_system: 2025 tabletop report; exercise calendar
what_it_shows: Only an IT tabletop (2025) was held; the OT annex, the crisis management team and field operations in South Florida and Alabama have not been exercised

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Incident log (10 of 31 incidents, 2025-2026); MDR contract; P08 draft runbooks; Security Manager and Control Room Manager interviews
what_it_shows: 10 of 10 sampled incidents triaged, IT hosts contained and reimaged, and lessons from 2 incidents used to update procedures; OT containment and recovery are not in the 2024 plan and appear only in the P08 drafts; handling is not coordinated with the pipeline emergency procedures; 2 of 10 incidents (USB malware on a South Florida HMI, a lost tablet in Alabama) were handled locally without a ticket for 3 and 6 days

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: 2024 incident response plan; draft P08 runbooks and OT annex; distribution list; Field Superintendent interviews
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan sets the roadmap, structure, reportable incidents, resources, sharing rules and responsibilities and is distributed to IT responders and the MDR provider; it has no OT annex, no link to Part 195 notices and no metrics; the OT annex and runbooks were unapproved drafts during fieldwork; Field Superintendents and the BCC had no copy; the plan was not updated after the 2025 OT DMZ and MDR changes

title: Control assessment: nonlocal maintenance
source_system: Jump host session log; vendor list; packager and flow computer vendor service agreements; compression station and Central Facility walkthroughs
what_it_shows: Jump host records are complete; packager and flow computer vendor sessions are not approved per session, monitored, recorded or ended by the company; packager sessions use a shared password with no MFA; the modem uses a dial-back number and a shared password; gateway network connections stay up permanently

title: Control assessment: media use
source_system: Endpoint control policy; kiosk log; inspection of South Florida and BCC HMIs
what_it_shows: USB storage blocked on OCC HMIs but allowed on South Florida and BCC HMIs, with no scanning kiosk there; 2 unlabeled USB drives with no identifiable owner found at the South Florida HMI desk

title: Control assessment: physical access
source_system: Badge reports; visitor logs (20 of 20); key inventory; gate combination log; walkthroughs of 4 tank batteries, 2 compression stations and 6 pads
what_it_shows: Badge access, visitor escort, audit logs, key security and the key and badge inventory work at the OCC, the BCC and the field offices; gate combinations are shared with contract crews by text message, changed yearly and not changed after 6 sampled field departures

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: Termination tickets (25 of 96); badge system and gate combination log; HR Director interview
what_it_shows: Access not disabled within 1 business day for 4 of 25 leavers (SCADA local accounts); controller passwords and gate combinations known to the 25 field leavers not changed outside the annual cycle; exit interviews, return of property and retention of the leaver's data documented for 25 of 25

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring
source_system: Scan reports; OT sensor vulnerability list; advisory tracking sheet; Security Analyst and OT Security Engineer interviews
what_it_shows: Quarterly authenticated corporate scans and passive OT monitoring at the OCC, analyzed and shared monthly; South Florida and Alabama field devices not monitored for vulnerabilities; CISA ICS advisories matched by hand for the OCC only; 3 of 46 corporate critical findings remediated late; no remediation timeframe for OT findings

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Contracts with system or data access (20 of 64); vendor review files; vendor-soc2-review.csv (P09)
what_it_shows: 9 of 20 sampled contracts contain security terms; privacy and breach notice terms are absent from the telematics and outside tax vendor contracts and from 11 of 20 sampled contracts; oversight is defined for the 4 SaaS vendors with annual SOC 2 reviews; no ongoing monitoring of OT vendors and no tiering of the 64 vendors

title: Control assessment: unsupported components
source_system: Asset list with support dates; SCADA vendor extended support agreement
what_it_shows: The BCC standby server and the 3 South Florida HMIs run an operating system past end of vendor support and have not been replaced; the SCADA vendor's extended support covers the SCADA application on the BCC server to 2027-06-30

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall rule exports (OT DMZ, BCC and South Florida site firewalls, cloud firewall); P04 diagram; external scan (2026-08-12); reachability test from a corporate workstation at the South Florida office (2026-08-11)
what_it_shows: 2 of 4 packager gateways accepted inbound internet connections with the packager's shared password, and from 1 of them the station PLC was reachable; no company device monitors the gateways or the vendor modem; the BCC and South Florida site firewalls allow remote desktop and file sharing from 3 corporate subnets, and the test reached the 3 South Florida HMIs and, through the BCC, the OCC historian; traffic into those segments is not monitored; public components sit behind the provider's web front door

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch reports; CAB tickets; critical vulnerability findings Q1-Q2 2026 (46 of 46); BCC and South Florida HMI patch levels
what_it_shows: Flaws identified and reported; OCC SCADA patches vendor-qualified and tested through the CAB; 43 of 46 corporate critical findings fixed within 30 days (3 took 41 to 58 days); the BCC standby server and South Florida HMIs unpatched since 2023; field device firmware updates not tested or applied in 2 years

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection
source_system: EDR console; allowlisting report; antivirus status of South Florida and BCC HMIs; test file on 5 corporate endpoints and 1 OCC engineering workstation
what_it_shows: EDR detected and quarantined the test file on 5 of 5 endpoints within 4 minutes and alerted the MDR provider; allowlisting blocked execution on the OCC engineering workstation; South Florida and BCC HMIs run antivirus with daily signature updates

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: MDR scope; OT sensor coverage map; OT sensor alert log (July 2026); simulated suspicious sign-in; legal opinion on monitoring
what_it_shows: The MDR provider escalated the simulated sign-in in 18 minutes; IT monitoring runs 24x7, with a 2025 legal opinion on monitoring; no OT monitoring at the South Florida office, Alabama field sites or the BCC; remote connections through the packager gateways and vendor modem not detected; 37 of 112 July OT sensor alerts arrived after hours and waited until the next business day

title: Control assessment: software, firmware and information integrity
source_system: Update verification log; allowlisting report; measurement data service ticket hashing; flow computer configuration records; Measurement Supervisor interview
what_it_shows: OCC SCADA software updates verified against vendor hashes; field device firmware authenticity not verified; flow computer and LACT configuration changes not captured or compared; running controller logic not compared with the repository outside the Panhandle; no defined action for unauthorized firmware or configuration changes

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments and reviews
source_system: Vendor review files; General Counsel and GRC Analyst interviews
what_it_shows: Supply chain risks of the SCADA integrator, the compressor packager and the flow computer vendor have never been assessed or reviewed
